positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Instruct labs and recitations of 30-55 students, hold office hours, debug code, and grade student work.
- Leverage C programming to create GameBoy Advance video games from scratch. (Course title: CS 2261)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Contributed to codebase of dynamic and scalable rules engine used for real-time data driven predictions.
- Iterated upon front-end design utilizing AngularJS.
- Designed comprehensive automated end-to-end tests.

positions.title: Distribution Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
- Designed, estimated, and implemented electrical distribution systems for commercial and residential use.
- Interacted with customers and contractors to improve and troubleshoot existing distribution systems.

positions.title: Surgical Assistant/ Lab Technician
positions.description:
- Fully assisted in surgeries: responsible for assisting lead surgeon, sterilizing surgical instruments, and sanitizing operation rooms.
- Organized patient records, scheduled appointments, and managed patients.

positions.title: Library Student Assistant
positions.description:
- Catalogued and integrated materials from GT Savannah campus library into the Georgia Tech Library.
- Processed library collections for GT and Emory library merger.

honors.title: James Dean Young Writing Award
